blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. BrickWright guides agents to create builds by writing code with BrickLayer, a Python toolkit with two main components: an ergonomic brick assembly API that halves inference cost compared to working in raw LDraw, and a validator that provides feedback on physical feasibility. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Additionally, they outperform specialized models on the text-to-brick task. Code is available on our project page: https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/
blocks.zh: 边疆编码代理商在3D建模方面越来越精通. 然而,在建造拟在物理世界组装的物体时,它们仍然面临挑战,这些物体往往用漂浮、碰撞或断开的部件制造无效的组件。 我们辩称,向代理人提供集成工具并核实其物理可行性足以使其产生实际有效的组件,这些组件仍然遵守输入提示。 聚焦于LEGO砖建领域,我们提出BrickWright,这是利用预试剂的文字或图像提示生成物理上可行的砖建的框架,如果建筑只使用真实部件,则在物理上可行,没有碰撞或浮动部件,并在可能时形成连接结构. BrickWright 引导代理通过与 BrickLayer 的写法代码创建构建,一个Python 工具包,主要组件有两种:一种是人造砖组装API,比在原始 LDraw 中工作时将推论成本减半,一种是提供物理可行性反馈的验证器. 基线制剂的物理有效性从只有9%(GPT-6 Luna)到69%(GPT-6 Astra)不等,而BrickWright制导的制剂在512个速率的样本上则达到100%的有效性,同时提高轻度制剂的迅速遵守性,并维持其更强的制剂. 此外,它们在文本对砖块任务上的表现超过了专门模式。 代码见我们的项目网页:https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Without additional fine-tuning, commercially available agents can successfully produce articulated objects [ 58 , 45 ] , scenes [ 52 ] , and constructive solid geometry models [ 27 ] .
However, they still face challenges when building objects for the physical world. We focus on the task of creating multi-part assemblies : real-world objects made from a set of prefabricated parts joined by fixed connectors, such as LEGO ® builds. Multi-part assemblies must obey multiple constraints: all parts must be drawn from a preset library, parts must not collide or float, and the joined parts typically form a single connected component.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)代理商在3D建模时越来越适合. 没有额外的微调,商业上可获得的物剂可以成功地产生清晰的物体[58,45],场景[52],以及建设性的固态几何模型[27].
然而,它们在为实体世界建造物体时仍然面临挑战。 我们侧重于创建多部分组件的任务:用一组由固定连接器(如LEGO QQ建筑)加入的预制部件制作的真人世界物体。 多段组件必须服从多个限制:所有部件必须从一个预设库中抽取,部件不得碰撞或漂浮,结合的部分一般形成一个单一的连接组件.

blocks.en: We argue that designing a toolkit for multi-part assembly creation is sufficient to enable agents to create physically valid builds. This toolkit should include (1) an assembly API , which provides an ergonomic programmatic interface for 3D creation; and (2) a validator , which provides feedback on a finished build’s physical validity. The need for a toolkit is independent of how powerful a coding agent is . We observe that GPT-6 Astra with Codex, when asked to make brick builds, already writes scripts to generate and validate its output more than 80% of the time ( Appendix D ). For complex physical domains, this self-validation is often not enough, resulting in builds that do not satisfy physical constraints, containing colliding, floating, or disconnected parts ( Fig. 2 ). Even if an agent is powerful enough to write a perfect toolkit, separately developing a toolkit remains important to reduce token usage and avoid repeated work. Existing toolkits for agentic 3D generation [ 58 , 45 ] are usually intended for digital asset creation; as they do not consider physical constraints, they cannot be repurposed as-is to create real-world objects.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,为多部分组装的创建设计一个工具包,足以使代理人能够创建物理上有效的建筑。 该工具包应包括 (1) 组装 API, 提供 3D 创建的 ergoomic 程序接口;和 (2) 验证器, 提供完成的建筑物理有效性的反馈. 对工具包的需求与编码代理人的强大程度无关。 我们观察到,GPT-6 Astra 与 Codex 当被要求制作砖块时,已经写了脚本来生成和验证其超过80%的时间(附录D)的输出. 对于复杂的物理域来说,这种自我验证往往是不够的,导致的构造不能满足物理约束,包含碰撞,漂浮,或断开的部分(图2). 即使一个代理人足够强大,可以写一个完美的工具包,但单独开发一个工具包对于减少象征性的使用和避免重复工作仍然很重要. 用于代理式3D生成[58,45]的现有工具包通常用于数字资产创建;由于它们不考虑物理约束,因此不能将其重新用于创建现实世界的物体.

blocks.en: We focus on the domain of LEGO ® generation as it is a commonly available yet complex system, consisting of thousands of parts that connect in dozens of ways. Our key insight is to merge agentic code-as-3D-models with the regularity of brick parts. Parts can be modeled as geometries with localized connectors that have programmatic rules for assembly (e.g., studs interlock with antistuds). From this perspective, we leverage the physical production rules for snap-fit brick builds [ 6 ] to create an ergonomic assembly API. Then, given an image or text prompt, our task is to generate a program using this API that, when compiled, produces a LEGO ® brick build in the standard LDraw format [ 21 ] . This build should include a list of library part placements, and it must be physically feasible , having no intersecting or floating parts and forming a connected structure if possible. While there are several specialized brick generation methods [ 50 , 10 , 11 , 19 , 37 , 48 , 36 , 53 ] , some of which consider physical constraints, they generally exhibit worse generalization and lower fidelity than commercial LLM agents on the same task. Hence, we wish to achieve this task agentically.
blocks.zh: 我们侧重于LEGO 的生成领域,因为它是一个常见但复杂的系统,由数千个以数十种方式连接的部分组成。 我们的关键洞察力是将代理代号-as-3D-模型与砖块部件的规律性合并. 零件可以被模拟为带有有编组程序规则的局部连接器的几何元器件(例如,螺旋柱与反弹夹). 从这个角度出发,我们利用物理生产规则 来建造短缝砖 [6] 来创建一个 人工合成的API。 然后,在图像或文本提示下,我们的任务是使用这个API生成一个程序,这个API在编译时会以标准 LDraw 格式生成 LEGO QQ 砖块构建 [21] 。 这一构件应包括一个库件放置清单,必须具有物理可行性,没有交叉或浮动部分,并尽可能形成一个相连的结构。 虽然有几种专门的砖木生成方法[50,10,11,19,37,48,36,53],其中一些方法考虑的是体力约束,但一般情况下它们表现出比商业LLM代理在相同任务上的更糟糕的概括性和更不忠实. 因此,我们希望积极完成这项任务。

blocks.en: Toward this goal, we introduce BrickLayer , a Python package for assembling and validating brick builds, alongside BrickWright , a framework that guides LLM agents through creating validated brick builds with BrickLayer. Agents equipped with BrickWright create higher-quality builds with fewer physical violations; on a test set of 512 prompts, all agents—including lightweight models like GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5—achieve a 100% validity score without a significant cost increase or drop in fidelity. BrickWright is especially useful for lightweight models: it improves Luna’s performance from 9% to 100% valid builds and boosts its prompt adherence at 2% the price of frontier models. BrickWright additionally outperforms specialized brick generation models on validity and fidelity. Code is available on our project page: avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright .
blocks.zh: BrickLayer是一个用于组装和验证砖块的 Python 软件包, 配有BrickWright的代理制造出质量较高的建筑,较少发生物理违规;在512个提示的测试集中,所有代理——包括GPT-6 Luna和Claude Haiku 5.5等轻量级模型——都实现了100%的有效性分数,而没有大幅度的成本增加或下降忠诚。 BrickWright对轻量级模型特别有用:它提高了Luna的性能,从9%提高到100%的有效建筑,并以2 %的前沿模型价格推动其迅速坚持。 BrickWright在有效性和忠诚性方面还超越了专门的砖块生成模型。 我们的项目网页:avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright 提供代码。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early work treats brick build generation as an optimization problem over a target shape. Legolization [ 34 ] voxelizes a 3D mesh, merges voxels into standard bricks, and iteratively re-merges regions identified as unstable. Subsequent work captures finer geometric detail through feature-aware shape approximation and non-rectangular bricks [ 57 , 59 ] , assembles bricks sequentially via Bayesian optimization [ 17 ] , or optimizes Technic assemblies to match annotated sketches [ 49 ] . Retrieval-based methods map images to figurines assembled from prebuilt templates [ 56 , 9 ] . These methods are limited by small brick vocabularies, explicit geometric guidance, or fixed templates.
blocks.zh: 早期的工作将砖砌生成视为一个相对于目标形状的优化问题. legolization [34] voxelize a 3D mesh,将 voxels 合并成标准砖块,并迭代重现被确定为不稳定的区域. 随后的作品通过地貌感知形状近似和非矩形砖[57,59]捕捉更细微的几何细节,通过巴耶西亚优化相继组装砖[17],或优化技术组件以匹配注释草图[49]. 基于检索的方法将图像映射到从预建模板组装的浮雕[56,9]. 这些方法受到小砖瓦词汇,显式几何导,或固定模板的限制.

blocks.en:
Learning-based methods generate brick structures directly from data. These approaches adapt graph generative models [ 41 ] , predict voxel representations that are assembled into bricks algorithmically [ 24 , 4 ] , learn sequential construction policies [ 7 ] , or use diffusion
to predict labeled voxels within a single category [ 10 ] . Autoregressive methods generate bricks conditioned on text or
images. BrickGPT [ 37 ] fine-tunes an LLM to generate stable structures, but is restricted to eight rectangular brick types across 21 object categories. LEGO-Maker [ 11 ] generates builds from images, but
supports only axis-aligned orientations and two categories. LegoACE [ 50 ] and BrickNet [ 19 ] scale to open-vocabulary generation by training on
large collections of human-designed builds. However,
LegoACE learns connectivity implicitly and can produce disconnected components, while BrickNet represents assemblies as connector graphs but accumulates collisions over longer build sequences. Brick-Composer [ 30 ] instead approaches assembly from target views as sequential brick selection and pose estimation, training a multimodal LLM on simulator-generated data and feedback. Other methods improve buildability through preference optimization or reinforcement learning [ 36 , 48 ] . In contrast, BrickWright utilizes pre-trained models to build arbitrary objects without task-specific training, verifies collisions and connectivity in a feedback loop, and supports articulation. Concurrent with our work, BrickBench [ 20 ] introduces a toolkit for agentic brick build creation, focusing on benchmarking the performance of different agents.

blocks.en: LLM agents have been used successfully to create 3D scenes. Recent works use a plan-execute-critique loop [ 15 , 29 ] or reconstruct scenes from images through iterative code execution and visual inspection [ 52 , 13 ] . Other works fine-tune LLMs to reason directly over 3D spatial inputs [ 44 ] or to generate tool-call trajectories [ 14 ] . These methods place objects in continuous space and rely on optimization or visual judgment to resolve collisions and floating objects. In BrickWright, explicit connector rules enable deterministic checks of attachment validity.
blocks.zh: LLM代理已经成功用于创建3D场景. 近期的作品使用一个计划-执行-critic 循环[15,29],或者通过迭代代码执行和视觉检查从图像中重建场景[52,13]. 其他作品对LLMs进行微调,使其直接通过3D空间输入进行推理[44]或生成工具调用轨迹[14]. 这些方法将物体放置在连续空间中,依靠优化或视觉判断来解决碰撞和浮动物体. 在BrickWright中,明确的连接器规则允许对附件有效性进行决定性的检查.

blocks.en:
Representing shapes as programs provides structured descriptions of geometry and part relationships [ 39 , 42 , 16 ] . Separately,
LLMs have been shown to reason more reliably when they write code and offload exact
computation to an interpreter [ 8 ] . Building on both ideas, agents have been applied to modeling individual objects as code, typically through plan-execute-critique loops. Prior work augments this loop with API retrieval [ 32 ] , domain-specific languages [ 45 ] , or procedural part-based modeling [ 27 ] , with some supporting articulation [ 45 , 27 , 58 , 23 ] . In CAD, LLMs have been
fine-tuned to generate parametric modeling code [ 47 , 12 , 18 ] , while tool-augmented agents generate and refine parts and assemblies [ 35 , 40 , 1 , 55 ] . Articraft [ 58 ] generates articulated assets using a custom SDK and a minimal harness that provides textual feedback from tools that probe the model code. Unlike these systems, where the agent generates geometry or infers inter-part relationships, BrickWright assembles fixed parts whose connectors determine how they attach and move.

blocks.en: To improve physical validity, prior work refines shapes or layouts after generation [ 5 , 51 , 54 , 29 , 25 ] , fine-tunes generators on simulator feedback [ 26 ] , or guides diffusion sampling with physical constraints [ 33 ] . Geometric analysis has also been used to plan LEGO assembly sequences without explicit connector information [ 2 ] . For brick structures, stability has been assessed through force-based equilibrium analysis [ 34 , 37 , 31 ] or physics simulation [ 17 , 46 ] . In contrast, BrickWright uses an executable verifier to check for collisions, floating parts, and connectivity, allowing a pre-trained agent to iteratively repair builds without task-specific training. Incorporating force-based stability analysis [ 34 , 31 ] is a natural extension.
blocks.zh: 为提高物理有效性,前期工作精细化造型或再生成布局[5,51,54,29,25],根据模拟器反馈对发电机进行微调[26],或以物理约束指导扩散取样[33]. 几何分析也被用于规划LEGO组装序列,没有明确的连接信息[2]. 对于砖木结构,稳定性是通过基于力的平衡分析[34,37,31]或物理模拟[17,46]来评估的. 相比之下,BrickWright使用可执行的验证器来检查碰撞,浮动部件,以及连接,允许一个预先训练过的代理在不经过任务特定训练的情况下进行迭代修复构建. 纳入以部队为基础的稳定性分析[34、31]是自然的延伸。

blocks.en: 3 BrickWright
blocks.zh: 3 砖瓦

blocks.en: Given a natural-language or image description, our task is to generate a physically feasible brick build from a fixed part catalog. A brick build is defined as an ordered sequence of placements . Each placement consists of an element or a nested brick build, together with a rigid transformation relative to the containing build. An element specifies a single part drawn from the catalog and a color. Elements expose typed connectors , such as studs, whose compatibility and relative alignment determine valid connections . A build is valid if it uses only catalog parts and contains no colliding (intersecting) or floating parts. It forms a connected component if one can draw a path of connections between any two elements in the build. We define a build to be physically feasible if it is valid and contains as few connected components as possible. More complex feasibility considerations, such as ensuring a build is stable and has an executable assembly sequence, are left to future work. Note that although having a single connected component is desirable as it makes a build less likely to break apart in the physical world, builds with multiple components are still necessary in some cases: for example, two separate vehicles in a car chase scene.
blocks.zh: 鉴于自然语言或图像描述,我们的任务是从固定的部分目录中生成一个实际可行的砖块建筑。 砖块建筑的定义是排列顺序。 每一放置由一个元件或嵌入式砖块建筑组成,同时相对于内置建筑进行刚性转换. 元素指定从目录中抽取的单个部分和一个颜色。 元素暴露出打字连接器,如螺旋,其兼容性和相对对齐性决定了有效的连接. 如果一个构件只使用目录部件,并且不包含碰撞(intersecting)或浮动部件,则该构件有效. 如果可以绘制构建中任意两个元素之间的连接路径,它就构成一个连接的组件. 我们定义一个建筑,如果它有效,并包含尽可能少的连通组件,则具有物理可行性. 更复杂的可行性考虑,例如确保建筑是稳定的,具有可执行的组装顺序,留给今后的工作处理。 请注意,虽然有一个单一的连接部件是可取的,因为它使得一个建筑在实体世界中不太可能被拆散,但在某些情况下仍有必要用多个部件建造:例如,在追车场中有两个单独的车辆.

blocks.en:
We introduce BrickWright ( Fig. 3 ), a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds using LLM agents.
Using a lightweight harness, BrickWright guides a single agent to write Python code that produces a brick build using a custom toolkit called BrickLayer . If the build passes a set of predefined and agent-written tests, it is accepted; otherwise, the agent makes edits informed by the test results, following the commonly used plan-execute-validate loop.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了BrickWright(图3),这是一个使用LLM代理生成物理上可行的砖块建筑的框架.
BrickWright使用轻量级的吊带,引导一个单一的代理编写Python代码,使用名为BrickLayer的自定义工具包生产砖块建筑. 如果构件通过一组预先定义的和代理写成的测试,则被接受;否则,代理按照常用的计划-执行-验证环路,根据测试结果进行编辑.

blocks.en: 3.1 BrickLayer
blocks.zh: 3.1 砖莱尔

blocks.en: LDraw [ 21 ] , the standard text format for LEGO ® builds, includes no physical validation and is not very ergonomic : it only allows users to place parts and sub-models by their absolute 3D poses. This makes it difficult to mate parts by their connectors or place them relative to others, which can lead to wasted tokens and misplaced components. To provide agents with an ergonomic interface for creating and validating brick builds, we introduce BrickLayer ( ), a Python package that includes functions for part discovery, assembly, and validation. BrickLayer provides a unified programmatic representation for brick builds, enabling them to be easily understood and edited by humans and agents; builds can be translated from BrickLayer to LDraw and vice versa. See Appendix B for BrickLayer documentation.
blocks.zh: LDraw [21],LEGO QQ构建的标准文本格式,不包含物理验证,也不十分人文化:它只允许用户用其绝对的3D外观放置部件和子模型. 这使其难以通过连接器将部件交配,或将其相对于其他部件放置,这可能导致废品和错误的部件. 为了为代理商提供一个用于创建和验证砖块建筑的工程学界面,我们引入了BrickLayer ( ),一个Python包,包含部分发现,组装,验证的功能. 砖头 地层为砖木建筑提供统一的方案代表,使其易于被人类和代理人理解和编辑;建筑可以从砖木莱尔翻译为LDraw,反之亦然. BrickLayer文档见附录B。

blocks.en: BrickLayer allows users to search the LDraw catalog [ 22 ] , which contains 17k+ parts. This search accepts keywords matched against the part’s official LDraw name. Results are ordered by their BM25 score [ 38 ] multiplied by a popularity factor that scales logarithmically with the number of official LEGO ® sets containing the part. LDraw names are parsed into fields such as category, subcategory, and dimensions; users may target specific fields with their keyword search and filter results using exact field matches.

blocks.en: The central objects of BrickLayer are Element , representing a single colored part, and LegoBuild , representing a brick build. Both objects support a unified LegoGeometry interface; this interface exposes dimensions and available connectors, which can be filtered by type and position. We use BrickNet’s connector annotations [ 19 ] , which mark the local frames of the connectors on each part, along with compatible connector types and the joints they form: fixed, revolute, ball, prismatic, or cylindrical. For example, studs and antistuds join with a revolute joint. As BrickNet annotations do not differentiate between prismatic and cylindrical joints, we determine a sliding joint’s type by rotating it 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} about its axis in one direction; if a collision occurs, we mark the joint prismatic.
blocks.zh: BrickLayer的中心物体是Elements,代表单一的彩色部分;LegoBuild,代表一个砖块建筑. 这两个对象都支持一个统一的乐高测量接口;这个接口暴露了维度和可用的连接器,这些连接器可以根据类型和位置过滤. 我们使用BrickNet的连接器说明[19],它标记了连接器的局部框架,以及兼容的连接器类型和它们构成的关节:固定的,转动的,球的,棱镜的,或圆柱的. 例如,柱子和抗震器与转动关节结合。 由于BrickNet的注解没有区分棱柱关节和圆柱关节,我们通过旋转15~15~15~circ)来决定滑动关节的类型,围绕轴向一个方向;如果发生碰撞,我们就标注联合棱柱。

blocks.en: LegoBuild s have a recursive structure: they may contain both Element s and other LegoBuild s, allowing complex models to be built from smaller components. Placements can be made at arbitrary poses, fixed to a grid, or by mating specified connectors. Users may name placements, allowing them to place components relative to or directly target the connectors of a named component. Users may also explicitly mark movable components with articulation limits corresponding to their joint type.
blocks.zh: 乐高Build s有一个递归结构:它们可能同时包含元素s和其他乐高Build s,允许从较小的组件中构建复杂的模型. 放置可以任意摆设,固定在网格上,也可以通过交配指定连接器进行. 用户可以命名放置,允许它们放置与某个命名组件的连接器相对的组件或直接瞄准这些组件. 用户也可以明确标记带有与其联合类型相对应的表达限制的可移动组件.

blocks.en: For convenience, BrickLayer includes several high-level construction functions, introduced after noting repeated patterns in agent-generated code. These include brick , plate , tile , slope , and inverted_slope to instantiate common parts by specifying their dimensions; minifigure , door , and window to create common multi-component sub-builds; mirror to reflect a build along a given axis; and fill_box , fill_slope , and fill_inverted_slope to fill a cuboid or wedge in a manner guaranteed to be valid and connected if possible.
blocks.zh: 为了方便,布瑞克 层包括几个高层次的构建功能,在注意到代理生成代码的重复模式后引入. 包括砖块、板块、瓦片、坡面和倒转的_斜坡,通过指定其尺寸来即时化普通部件;小图、门和窗口,以创建共同的多构件子构件;镜像,以反映沿着给定轴的构件;以及填充_框、填充_斜坡和填充_倒转的_斜坡,以保证有效的方式填充立方体或楔形。

blocks.en: A LegoBuild provides methods to list collisions, floating elements, and disconnected components. To determine whether two elements collide, we inset each mesh by 0.1 mm before checking for intersections, following BrickNet; snap connections between bricks are so tight that a naive mesh intersection check would report a false positive. The floater check first translates a build so its lowest point is at the ground plane. Then, it marks an element floating if it cannot reach a grounded element through mated connectors or supporting surface contacts . A surface contact is supporting if it has an upward component; lateral contact alone is insufficient. Two connectors form a connection if their local frames align, depending on their joint type; for example, a fixed joint requires the two frames to align exactly, while a revolute joint additionally admits a rotational degree of freedom. For builds with user-annotated articulations, a posed method allows an agent to create a snapshot of the build with joints set to specified articulation parameters, to validate physical feasibility under joint motion. Posing works with models whose kinematic structure forms a tree.
blocks.zh: 一个乐高Build提供了列出碰撞,浮动元素,和断开组件的方法. 为了确定两个元素是否碰撞,我们在检查交叉点之前将每个网格插入0.1毫米,紧跟在BrickNet之后;砖块之间的断线连接非常紧密,以至于一个天真网格交叉点检查会报告一个假阳性. 浮标检查首先翻译一个建筑,所以其最低点在地面平面. 然后,如果无法通过交配连接器或支持表面接触来达到一个被锚定的元素,它就标志着一个浮着的元素. 如果表面接触具有向上部分,则支持接触;仅横向接触是不够的。 两个连接器如果其局部帧对齐,则视其关节类型而形成连接;例如,一个固定的连接器要求两个帧精确对齐,而一个转动的连接器额外承认旋转自由度. 对于使用用户附加说明的构件,一个设置的方法允许一个代理人用设定为特定构件参数的关节来制作构件的快照,以验证联合运动下的物理可行性. Posing与运动结构形成树的模型合作.

blocks.en: 3.2 Building with BrickLayer
blocks.zh: 3.2 与BrickLayer一起建造的大楼

blocks.en: BrickWright is a framework for agentic brick build creation using BrickLayer. It provides a single agent with a set of tools and prompts it to create a build by writing and revising a single Python file in a plan-execute-validate loop, inspired by Articraft [ 58 ] . The BrickWright environment exposes the tools validate , which runs agent-written tests alongside fixed collision and floating checks; render , which renders the build into a multi-view sheet or from a single specified view; and finalize , which marks the build as finished.
blocks.zh: BrickWright是使用BrickLayer制造代理砖块的框架. 它为单一代理提供了一套工具,并促使其通过在计划-执行-验证循环中编写和修订单一的Python文件来创建一个构建,灵感来自Articraft [58]. BrickWright环境暴露了工具验证,这些工具在固定碰撞和浮动检查的同时进行代理笔试;渲染,使构建成为多视图工作表或从单一指定视图;以及最后敲定,将构建标记为完成。

blocks.en:
In its system prompt, BrickWright instructs an agent to make a short internal plan, then write a Python file, build.py , containing two functions: create_build() , which returns a LegoBuild , and run_tests() , which runs a set of agent-written tests against the completed build.
After creating build.py , the agent is instructed to iteratively call validate and edit the build file until all tests pass, then call render ; if it judges the render satisfactory, it should then call finalize ; otherwise, it should revise build.py and repeat validation. Besides these instructions, BrickWright includes only the BrickLayer documentation in its system prompt, and the input text or image in a user prompt. It does not provide the agent with detailed planning advice, complete build examples, or building tips beyond the plan-execute-validate loop; the loop alone is sufficient for even lightweight agents to produce a feasible build.
blocks.zh:
BrickWright在它的系统中即时指示一个代理商做一个简短的内部计划,然后写一个Python文件,构建. py, 包含两个函数: 创建_ building( ), 返回一个乐高构建( ) , 运行一组针对已完成构建的代理写测试 。
在创建 build.py 后, 代理被指示进行迭代调用验证并编辑构建文件, 直至所有测试通过, 然后调用渲染 ; 如果它判断渲染是否令人满意, 然后调用最终 ; 否则, 它应该修改构建 。 py和重复验证. 除这些指令外,BrickWright只在其系统提示中包含BrickLayer文档,并在用户提示中包含输入文本或图像. 它没有向代理商提供详细的规划建议,完整的构建实例,或者在计划-执行-验证环路之外构建提示;仅此环路就足以让即使是轻量级代理商产生可行的构建.

blocks.en: BrickWright can be used alongside commercial frameworks such as Codex, which allows general file access and script execution. However, to demonstrate its utility alone, we provide the agent with only two additional tools during experiments: read / write / insert / edit_build to read and modify build.py , and explore to run a Python snippet with BrickLayer and the written LegoBuild in scope, returning its output as text.
blocks.zh: BrickWright可以和Codex等商业框架一起使用,后者允许一般文件访问和脚本执行. 然而,仅仅为了证明它的效用,我们在实验期间只为代理提供了两个额外的工具:读 / 写 / 插入 / 编辑_ 构建读 和修改 build.py ,并探索用 BrickLayer 和书面的 LegoBuild 在范围中运行一个 Python 片断,返回其输出为文本.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We compare BrickWright against two types of baselines: specially trained text-to-brick models (BrickGPT [ 37 ] and BrickNet [ 19 ] ) and pre-trained agentic methods (Articraft [ 58 ] , OpenAI’s Codex, and Anthropic’s Claude Code). We evaluate the physical feasibility and prompt adherence of the output brick builds. Throughout evaluation, we use the BrickNet-512 [ 19 ] dataset, which contains 512 text prompts created by VLM captioning of human-made brick builds.
blocks.zh: 我们比较BrickWright与两类基准:经过专门训练的文本对砖模型(BrickGPT[37]和BrickNet[19])和经过预先训练的代理方法(Articraft[58],OpenAI的代码和Anthropic的Claude代码)。 我们评价产出砖建筑的实际可行性和迅速遵守。 在整个评价过程中,我们使用BrickNet-512[19]数据集,其中包含由人造砖建筑的VLM字幕创建的512个文本提示.

blocks.en: To test agents with a range of capabilities, we run experiments with Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna (lightweight), GPT-6.1 Sol (balanced), and GPT-6 Astra (frontier). All agents use High reasoning. Figure examples use Astra unless otherwise specified. Agents are instructed to create builds with no collisions or floaters, and to ensure the build is connected if it comprises one object. Codex and Claude Code baselines may read, write, and execute arbitrary files in a workspace directory, which initially contains only the LDraw documentation [ 21 ] and the library of LDraw parts [ 22 ] , including part meshes. BrickWright agents are only allowed to read and modify the output build.py and execute text-output-only Python snippets; they have no access to the LDraw documentation or LDraw part library beyond the searchable parts list exposed by BrickLayer. Agentic methods have a budget of $5 per sample; for samples that reach the budget, we use the latest completed build, whether valid or invalid. Only Luna w/o assembly API (2 samples) and Astra with Codex (1 sample), Articraft (34 samples), and full BrickWright (2 samples) reached this limit.

BrickWright代理只允许读取和修改输出构建. py 并执行文本输出的 Python 片段;他们无法访问 LDraw 文档或 BrickLayer 曝光的可搜索部分列表以外的 LDraw 部分库. 代理方法的预算为每个样本5美元;对于达到预算的样本,我们使用最新完成的建筑,无论是有效的还是无效的。 只有Luna w/o组装API(2个样本)和Astra与Codex(1个样本),Articraft(34个样本),以及完整的BrickWright(2个样本)达到这个极限.

blocks.en: As Articraft is intended for primitive-based 3D generation, we minimally modify it to use a library of LDraw part meshes rather than mesh primitives. Invalid operations on physical parts (e.g., scaling) are disabled, as are collision checks, which yield false positives for coupled bricks, and watertightness checks, which fail on library meshes. We adjust Articraft’s system prompt to reword phrases that do not work with brick builds, such as allowing geometry overlaps.
blocks.zh: 由于Articraft的本意是用于原始的3D生成,我们很少修改它,以使用LDraw part meshes的库而不是网状原始人. 物理部件(如缩放)上无效的操作被禁用,碰撞检查也禁用,碰撞检查对组合砖产生假阳性,水密检查对库网失效. 我们调整了Articraft的系统,以重写那些与砖块结构不起作用的短语,例如允许几何重叠。

blocks.en: We report metrics on physical feasibility as defined in Sec. 3 ; prompt adherence as judged by VQAScore [ 28 ] , Perception Encoder [ 3 ] , and SigLIP 2 [ 43 ] ; average brick count per build; and average time and cost per prompt. Validity and connectivity are first evaluated using BrickLayer’s validator. Then, to independently verify the metrics’ accuracy, we flag potential false positives for review by a human experienced with LEGO ® design. Potential false positives include collisions resolved by a tested shift of at most 0.2 mm and disconnected components containing parts without connector annotations. Human review increases collision-free rates by 0.2 percentage points for BrickNet and Claude Code (Haiku), 1.4 for Codex (Sol), and 1.0 for Codex (Astra). It reduces mean component counts by 0.13 for Codex (Sol), 0.10 for Codex (Astra), and 0.12 for Articraft; changes for the remaining methods are below 0.02 components per build. Numbers in Tab. 1 are post-review.
blocks.zh: 我们报告第3节所界定的物理可行性的衡量标准;根据VQAScore [28]、Pepeption Encoder [3]和SigLIP 2 [43] 的判断,迅速遵守;每座建筑平均砖块计数;以及每座迅速的平均时间和成本。 使用 BrickLayer 的验证器, 然后,为了独立验证测量的准确性,我们标出潜在的假阳性,供具有LEGO 设计经验的人审查。 潜在的假阳性包括:通过试验的最多0.2毫米的移位和含有没有连接器说明的部件的断开部件来解决碰撞。 人类审查使BrickNet和Claude Code(海库)的无碰撞率提高了0.2个百分点,Codex(Sol)提高了1.4个百分点,Codex(Astra)提高了1.0个百分点。 它将Codex(Sol)的平均组件数减少0.13个,Codex(Astra)减少0.10个,将Articraft(Articraft)减少0.12个;其余方法的变化低于每块0.02个组件。 Tab中的数字. 1是事后审查。

blocks.en: 4.1 Baseline comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 基线比较

blocks.en: Compared to vanilla agent baselines, builds produced by BrickWright-equipped agents exhibit greatly improved physical feasibility with broadly comparable token costs ( Tab. 1 ). Impressively, the lightweight model Luna, which has only a 9% baseline validity rate, achieves 100% validity when used with BrickWright. This increase in physical validity is not accompanied by a significant decrease in complexity or fidelity; on average, BrickWright agents use more bricks and more unique parts than vanilla agent baselines, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight models (Haiku, Luna) and maintaining it for powerful models (Sol, Astra). These gains hold even with BrickWright’s minimal harness, whereas Codex and Claude Code can read, write, and execute arbitrary files. BrickWright-equipped agents additionally outperform specially trained text-to-brick models in overall feasibility and prompt adherence. The Articraft baseline, which is intended for digital 3D assets, yields comparable prompt adherence but worse physical validity at more than twice the cost of BrickWright. The visual results in Fig. 6 show how BrickWright reduces physical artifacts for all agent backends and improves the coherence of builds created by lightweight agents. On average, most BrickWright agents use 2–3 validate calls; Luna uses 4–5 ( Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 与香草剂基线相比,布克赖特装备的剂制造的建筑显示出了大幅提高的物理可行性,其象征性成本大致相当(附件1)。 令人印象深刻的是,只有9%基线有效率的轻量级模型Luna在与BrickWright一起使用时达到了100%的有效性. 身体有效性的这种提高并没有伴随着复杂性或忠诚度的显著下降;平均来说,布克赖特剂比香草剂基线使用更多的砖块和更独特的零件,同时提高轻量级模型(海库,月球)的迅速坚持性,并维持它用于强大的模型(索尔,阿斯特拉). 即使BrickWright用最少的绳索, 在总体可行性和迅速遵守方面,布克Wright装备的代理商还超越了经过专门培训的文本对砖模型。 用于数字三维资产的Articraft基线迅速获得相当的遵守,但实际有效性更差,其成本是BrickWright的两倍以上。 Fig. 6的视觉结果展示了BrickWright如何减少所有代理后端的物理文物,并提高轻量级代理所创造的建筑的一致性. 平均来说,大多数BrickWright代理使用2–3验证呼叫;Luna使用4–5(Tab. 1).

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 4.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate BrickLayer’s two key components: the assembly API and the validator. In our first ablation, “w/o assembly API”, agents write a program that creates an LDraw file without using BrickLayer’s assembly functions. The LegoBuild abstraction is removed from BrickLayer, leaving only part search and physical validation, and its documentation is replaced by LDraw documentation of similar length. In our second ablation, “w/o validator”, agents are still told to make their output physically valid but cannot use the validate and render tools or BrickLayer’s physical validation functions. They are allowed to run their own validations using explore . We run ablations using Haiku, Luna, and Sol; we exclude Astra due to budget constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了BrickLayer的两个关键组成部分:集合API和验证器。 代理商在第一个blogy, “w/o 组装 API ” 中会写一个程序, 不使用 BrickLayer 的组装功能而创建 LDraw 文件 。 乐高Build抽象从BrickLayer中移除,只留下部分搜索和物理验证,其文档被类似长度的LDraw文档所取代. 在我们的第二次验证中,“w/o验证器”仍然告诉代理商要使其输出在物理上有效,但不能使用验证并渲染工具或BrickLayer的物理验证功能。 允许他们使用探索进行自己的验证。 我们使用Haiku、Luna和Sol等工具,

blocks.en: BrickLayer’s assembly API greatly reduces token usage and makes it easier to create valid builds; when forced to work in LDraw rather than using LegoBuild , agents spend around twice the token cost and three times as many validate calls ( Tab. 1 ). Though stronger agents (Sol) still achieve 100% validity with no assembly API, weaker agents (Luna and Haiku) sometimes give up without finalizing the build, leading to validity scores below 100%. Without an assembly API, Luna’s prompt-similarity scores degrade significantly; it often produces simple structures ( Fig. 4 ) and its average part count drops from 27.4 to 7.2. Interestingly, merely using BrickLayer’s API without a provided validator boosts validity by up to 44 percentage points from Codex/Claude Code baselines! The automatic grid-snapping and connector-mating functions provided by BrickLayer help agents, especially lightweight ones, produce valid builds more easily. However, the validator remains a crucial component; without it, all agents score below 79% validity ( Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: BrickLayer的组装API极大地减少了象征性的使用,并更容易创建有效的建筑;当被迫在LDraw工作而不是使用LegoBuild时,代理商花费大约2倍于象征性成本和3倍于验证呼叫(Tab. 1 ). 虽然较强的代理(Sol)仍然在没有组装API的情况下达到100%的有效性,但较弱的代理(Luna和Haiku)有时在未最终完成构建的情况下放弃,导致有效性分数低于100%. 没有组装API,Luna的速同分数就会显著下降;它经常产生简单的结构(图4),其平均部分计数从27.4下降到7.2. 有趣的是,仅仅使用BrickLayer的API而未提供验证器,就可以提高有效性,比Codex/Claude代码基线高出44个百分点! 由BrickLayer帮助代理商,特别是轻量级代理商提供的自动网格绘制和连接器映射功能,可以更容易地产生有效的建筑. 然而,验证员仍然是一个关键的组成部分;没有验证员,所有代理商的评分都低于79%(表1)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Extensions
blocks.zh: 4.3 延期

blocks.en: BrickWright works with image conditions, indoor and outdoor scenes, large-scale builds of more than 29,000 parts, articulated objects, build editing by providing a BrickLayer script or LDraw file as input, and special requirements such as being constrained to a given set of bricks ( Fig. 5 ). This functionality naturally arises from pre-trained agent capabilities, without needing to update BrickWright’s toolkit.
blocks.zh: BrickWright作品有图像条件,室内和室外场景,大型建筑超过29,000个部件,清晰的物体,通过提供BrickLayer脚本或LDraw文件作为输入来构建编辑,以及诸如被限制在某一组砖块(图5)等特殊要求. 这种功能自然产生于预先训练的代理能力,不需要更新BrickWright的工具包.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Frontier coding agents are capable of producing aesthetically pleasing LEGO ® brick builds from text or image prompts. However, even the most capable agents fail to produce physically feasible builds much of the time. Our framework, BrickWright, closes this gap by introducing a toolkit for brick build creation and validation. Equipped with BrickWright, even lightweight agents achieve 100% validity on 512 samples tested, while improving prompt adherence at a similar cost to agents without BrickWright. We hope this work highlights the importance of well-written construction APIs and physical validation in improving the performance of LLM agents on building tasks.
blocks.zh: 边疆编码代理人能够从美学上取悦LEGO 的砖块,用文字或图像提示。 然而,即使是最有能力的制剂也未能生产出物理上可行的物剂,这在大部分时间都是积累起来的。 我们的框架,BrickWright,通过推出砖砌创建和验证工具包来弥补这一差距. 配备了BrickWright,即使是轻量级的剂在测试的512个样品上也取得了100%的有效性,同时以与不配备BrickWright的剂类似的成本提高了快速的坚持性. 我们希望这项工作突出写得好的建筑API和实物验证对于改善LLM代理在建筑任务上的表现的重要性.

blocks.en: Our definition of physical feasibility does not cover valid assembly sequences or stability analysis, which we leave to future work. Though agentic methods outperform specially trained models on brick build generation, they are generally slower and more costly. Effectively distilling the capabilities of powerful agents into smaller, faster models remains an interesting future direction.
blocks.zh: 我们对物理可行性的定义并不包括有效的组装序列或稳定性分析,我们留待未来工作处理。 虽然代理方法在砖建造发电方面超过了经过专门培训的模型,但一般速度较慢,成本较高。 有效地将强大物剂的能力提炼成更小,更快的模型,仍然是今后一个有趣的方向.

blocks.en: Table 2 breaks down the reasons for failed validate calls. blocks.en: We give a short analysis of the brick build creation process of baseline GPT-6 Astra, used with Codex. We inspect the Python programs produced and executed by the agent during generation (whether inline or from a file) and classify them as generators and/or validators by using heuristics that trace the program’s abstract syntax tree (AST). If a program calls write_text() or write_bytes() on a model.ldr file or open s the file in a mode with write access, we classify it as a generator. If a program reads model.ldr and includes an assertion or error involving values derived from model.ldr , we classify it as a validator. Out of 512 builds created using prompts from BrickNet-512, 471 (92%) use a generator and 424 (83%) use a validator.

blocks.zh: 列出 8: 连接器文档. 连接符(Connector)是一个元素或构造上的键入交配点. 连接器带有本地帧和长度;兼容性和相对帧对齐决定了有效的连接. BrickLayer API参考文献摘录.
